about.title: A family-owned collective of companies
text: Green Dynasty is a proudly family-owned and operated collective of companies based in Texas, committed to delivering high-quality construction and real estate services to our community. Founded on integrity, transparency and exceptional customer care, every client is treated like family and every project is handled with meticulous attention to detail.

Our journey began with Bobby and Sherry Green, a husband-and-wife team dedicated to creating solutions that simplify life for families and businesses. Sherry Green, a proud Brazilian-American leader, guides the construction division, which is known for quality workmanship, innovative solutions and a focus on long-term value.

Each branch of the group shares the same mission. Green Dynasty Construction builds and remodels, Green Dynasty Real Estate provides investor-focused services and pre-purchase contractor walkthroughs, and Green Dynasty Vault handles packouts and secure storage while the work is under way.

faqs.a: No. Every estimate starts with an on-site walkthrough. Photos and existing estimates help us prepare, but they don't replace the visit.

faqs.q: What estimating software do you use?
faqs.a: We estimate in Xactimate using our own subscription. You receive both the editable ESX file and a PDF.

faqs.q: Do you estimate new construction from plans?
faqs.a: No. We don't do new-construction takeoffs or bid packages from plans or blueprints. Our estimates are based on an on-site walkthrough of an existing home or building.

A packout is when a professional team packs up the contents of your home, or specific rooms, documents everything, moves it to secure storage, and returns it later. It's a common choice during remodels, moves, and home sales.

faqs.q: Do I need to pack the whole house?
faqs.a: No. We can pack a single room, a few rooms, or the entire home. During a kitchen or bathroom remodel, for example, many homeowners only need nearby rooms cleared.

faqs.q: Will you put everything back when the project is done?
faqs.a: Yes. Our pack-back service returns your belongings to your home and helps place items in the rooms where they belong.

faqs.q: Do you estimate residential and commercial projects?
faqs.a: Yes. We write itemized estimates for homes, offices, retail spaces and multi-unit properties.

faqs.q: Can I use your estimate for an insurance claim?
faqs.a: Yes. The estimate is yours, and you can share it with your insurance company, contractor or anyone helping with the project. We don't represent you with the insurance company or negotiate your claim.

faqs.q: Can you review an estimate I already have?
faqs.a: Yes. We'll compare it against the conditions documented on site and write any supported differences, with notes explaining each item.

faqs.q: How much does an estimate cost?
faqs.a: Talking through your project is free, and if you hire Green Dynasty Construction to do the work your estimate is free. For an estimate only, our fee is 2% of the completed Xactimate estimate with a $450 minimum, and we go over it before we schedule.

faqs.q: How long does an estimate take?
faqs.a: Most estimates are ready within 3 business days of the walkthrough.

faqs.q: How do I know what was packed?
faqs.a: We create an inventory of your contents as part of every packout, so you have a record of what left your home and what's coming back.

faqs.q: How long can my belongings stay in storage?
faqs.a: It depends on your needs. Whether it's a short remodel or a longer gap between homes, we'll work with you on a timeline that fits your plans.

faqs.q: How do I get started on a packout?
faqs.a: Give us a call. We'll talk through your project, your timeline and what needs to be packed, then schedule a walkthrough.
